messages:
maria: quick copy QA  we updated the confirmation dialog users see when terminating a long-running training job. want a short pass for clarity + a11y before the patch.
choi: current CTA is 'Confirm' which is too generic. users should know if checkpoints/snapshots are preserved.
jess: agree. also call out billing impact and whether GPUs are freed. small, explicit is better than vague.
maria: draft copy: header 'Terminate training job' body 'This will stop the training job immediately. Checkpoints not pushed to persistent storage may be lost. Billing for compute stops when the job terminates.' primary button 'Terminate job' secondary 'Cancel' inline link 'Push checkpoints'
choi: prefer keeping primary short and adding aria-label for screen readers: aria-label="Terminate training job and drop unpushed checkpoints"
a11y-bot: a11y notes: set initial focus to Cancel, add aria-describedby on the primary button pointing to the body, and ensure the inline 'Push checkpoints' link has descriptive accessible name. avoid autofocus on destructive actions.
dev-bot: implementation note: add analytics event job.terminate.confirm with flag checkpoint_pushed. i'll add unit tests for aria-describedby and focus order.
product-bot: please add i18n keys: modal.job.terminate.title/body/primary/secondary and track event modal.job.terminate_shown.
maria: thanks all  I'll update the Figma and drop the final copy into the PR. if no objections i'll merge tomorrow.
